notes.title: Monday Musings #24 – Scythe & Spindle - Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
I knew at EA launch that Entropy as an adversary would be something that evolved over the course of development, but more than that I also knew I needed feedback to guide the ultimate shape MoteMancer's adversary would take. We've had many late-night community conversations about where we might be able to evolve Entropy, and today I'm going to share the fruits of those discussions.

[h3]Entropy as a Resource[/h3] 
The best way at a foundational level to change the way players interact with Entropy is to make it harvestable and useful rather than just something to carve into or build around. Entropy represents the unraveling of order, thread by thread, into a miasma of noise without enough structure to cohere into anything descript. For an experimenting alchemist, this means it could be leveraged in a multitude of novel and interesting ways.

We'll start with the [b]Entropic Alembic[/b], which distills nearby Entropy into [b]Entropic Shards[/b] - a crystallized reagent used as the foundation of our new arcane endeavors. From there, the [b]Transmutation Engine[/b] channels the chaotic potential of Entropy in a variety of forms. 

Early on, the Engine’s primary use-case is coaxing random Motes back from Entropy using Salt or Aether as a catalyst - reconstituting the Entropic Shard back into that which it dissolved. The random nature of the output adds for interesting logistical challenges, but can also always be turned back into Salt and Aether, since a Grindstone is undiscerning in that regard. Grippers will only pickup Ingredients that are useable in their destination Inventory as well, so there are many clever ways to filter a line, even before Enchanted and Stonebound techs come online. 

Beyond that, the Transmutation Engine allows you to cycle items through their Elemental counterparts. Accidentally bring 100 Streamways to the Fire plane where they can't be placed? Use the Transmutation Engine to convert them into Wide Chests or Ichor Slick, whatever suits your preference.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567834/130d22700e3c03a4b3620b5443116adcc77c2ac9.png[/img]        [i]Early Entropy Development[/i]

[h3]Inter-Planar Logistics[/h3]
Right now all of the Planar Portals have their cross-plane bridges on all the time, but it was always planned for this to be earned one way or another, and Entropy's kit of slicing through the planes is a perfect place for this tech to unlock. Each Element has its own style of Planar Bridging, and each can be earned through Entropy Research.

Alongside these planar bridges comes a new feature - [b]Planar Reliquary[/b], which allows you to place an in-world "Chest" of sorts that is linked regardless of distance to a reserved slot in your inventory. The easiest use-case for this is to fill it from a Crafter or a line so that you always have a stack of your go-to Structures at hand, but since it lives in the world, it can also be used as a trash slot or canary buffer for whether a supply chain is running low or topped off.

[h3]Spindle & Scythe[/h3]
For players that would rather just prevent Rifts from spawning so they can build in peace - [b]Spindle [/b]is a Diamond-shelled structure that holds a core of Entropy, keeping a local balance and preventing Rifts from reacting to nearby complexity. Spindles effectively stitch the seams of reality together, and has a research line that pushes Entropy back in a variety of ways. [b]Scythe [/b]on the other hand tears reality asunder, concentrating so much abundant Power in a location that a Rift can't help but open to feast on the concordance of energy. Scythe gameplay is about beckoning Entropy into your world so that it may be reaped and exploited.

[h3]Feeding the Cycle[/h3]
Entropy Research is a brand new tech tree that lives alongside the existing elemental tree. Research is simply commenced through cleansing nearby Entropy and Rifts, through Spells or Towers (but notably not through the Entropic Alembic). This gives players a clear path of bonus for killing Rifts, or farming it outright for new avenues of gameplay. There are a few extra goodies buried in the tree, but those you'll have to discover for yourself.

The Entropy Update is encroaching on the horizon - prepare your defenses or distilleries for the dance ahead.

~CyanAvatar

notes.title: Patch 0.1.452 - Fully Mastered OST and a new Experimental Branch.
notes.notes:
Ok fellow alchemists, today marks a state of evolution for MoteMancer.

Today's patch is light on the primary build but introduces a new Experimental branch of the game for people that want to test upcoming features.  If you want to participate, in Steam you can right-click the app and go into: 
[i]Properties->Betas ->Experimental [/i]
and set your game up for that.  More on this specific Experimental version in a bit, but first I also want to say, the Entropy Update is coming fast, and because it is so complex, I am likely to hold off on hitting an exact patch date next week, but will also likely push a version of it to the Experimental branch around that time. If you'd like to get those updates I highly encourage joining our Discord community. Either way it will be live very soon.

More details will come on Monday's Musings.

[h3]Patch 0.1.452 [/h3]
[list]
[*] Fully Mastered Music tracks have been finalized. Every Element has 4 tracks, there is a possibility more will be added in the far future, but the OST volume 1 is locked. I will be updating the Steam download alongside the Entropy Update.

[*] F1 reporting has changed under the hood to show which version of the game bugs are being reported from, so rest assured no matter which branch you are playing in, I will have the information needed to address it. Thank you everyone sincerely for all of your bug reports and patience, the game is better today because of you.
[/list]

[h3]Patch 0.1.454 - Experimental[/h3]

Please note: Games made here are [b][u]not[/u][/b] backwards compatible (if you drop from experimental to default, your terrain will be incorrect). I am planning on keeping old bases intact for as long as possible, but the code is branched to support this, and bug fixing for the old branch specifically is not likely. Starting with the Entropy update, we'll version up to 0.2.xxx, which will signify that any game saved in that suite of patches should be fully supported. We will likely version up again once Affixes are fully implemented. I will give a roadmap update in the coming weeks to clarify all of this.

[list]
[*] Random world seeds are available!  Currently starting a new game will roll a random seed for terrain and Mote/Portal generation.
[*] Portal distances have been reigned in a lot past the first ring.
[*] Seismic Flare will now find the nearest portal regardless of whether you have seen it or not.
[/list]

Thank you once again for being along for the journey. MoteMancer is evolving quickly thanks to your continued feedback and support.

notes.title: Weekly Patch - Build v0.1.451 - [M] for Map! plus the usual bug fixes and QoL
notes.notes:
[h3][M] Map is now available! [/h3]
[list]
[*] Maps will show terrain, Entropy, and Structures as pixels.
[*] Mote Fields, Portals, and the Player have icons that remain anchored to the edges of the map and clickable for fast centering.
[*] NOTE: The map will [u]Not[/u] automatically populate from a save prior to this update, but will populate as you move around. New saves will permanently save the revealed map. You will need to visit each Plane you have a base on to reveal it for the first time.
[/list]

[h3]QOL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bastions, Cultivators, and Lava Generators now use unrestricted inventories (as opposed to input only), allowing you to daisy-chain their inventory slot contents to and from each other.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could make a Mote Field total Motes show an incorrect value.
[*] Fixed Mystical Agriculture's giant research icon in Alt Mode
[*] Fixed a few bugs around Player Mana upgrade calculations.
[*] Fix for Torrential Streamways sometimes getting destroyed on load when over a Chasm.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause Rifts to spawn additional Entropy tiles from Load Game when they shouldn't.
[*] Ember Collector tooltips no longer refer to Cinder Collectors
[/list]

notes.title: Weekly Update - Build v0.1.443 (Update - 446 Hotfixes)
notes.notes:
[h3]Hotfix v0.1.446[/h3]

Ok so i went a little overboard with this 'hotfix'

[list]
[*] Torrential Streamways can be built over Chasms now
[*] Gust Funnels now power all adjacent tiles (power area only). Give feedback on whether this is confusing or cool, Future visual fx will still help for sure.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Looping structure sounds will no longer phase in time, leading to weird overlaps
[*] Fix for game stuttering on load
[*] Fix Sovereign Manaheart information in the Power Window
[*] Fix for Cultivator power window accidentally showing Fire stats
[*] Plane blocker text now has a 2 second delay when trying to place instead of just per tile spam
[*] Fix bad plane blocker string for Water
[/list]

[h3]Build v0.1.443[/h3]
New Power Window section, Audio Performance improvements, and a handful of Quality of Life updates and bug fixes.

World Map [i]almost[/i] made it this week, but could stand to use a little polish before going live.

Thanks everyone for all of your suggestions and bug reports!
~Cyan

[h3]QoL[/h3]
[b]New Power Window section (please give feedback on this!): [/b]
* Modally shifts between Life/Fire/Air styles.
* Shows additional stats like maximums or overage percentages.
* Shows more stats about Air and Fire systems specifically for better understanding of what drives power generation.

* If holding an item while a matching corner craft finishes, increment the held item rather than sending the item straight to the player inventory.
* A flavorful Player feedback popup will play when trying to build a structure from an opposing plane.
* Crafting Corner now has reminder for showing Inventory is Full.
* Wavedash and Swiftstone bonuses have a one-tile slush range.

[h3]Performance[/h3]
[b]Significant audio rework to further improve performance.[/b]
+ Looping sounds no longer use colliders. Instead only structures in the player's chunk or neighboring chunks can play their looping sounds. 
+ Looping sounds now have attenuation (only the 5 closest structures playing the same clip will now play, others will blend off or on respectively). 
+ Looping audio sources are now pooled.
+ Delay between music tracks now uses real time instead of game time. 

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
* Better chunk collision handling and loading logic (should stop at least some of the chunks loading slowly/not at all issues).
* Hovered structure can now change even if your mouse coord doesn't. (Fixes multiple rotations in place or pipette after rotation bugs).
* Clear orb progression before loading a new game or returning to the main menu because it can put the portal in a weird state in the tutorial.
* Fixed a bug that could cause weird graphical flicker on belt items.
* Shattered recipes no longer contribute to allow lists for inventories (you can no longer place a Verdant Collector into the input of an Arboretum).
* Mystical Agriculture research no longer has a giant icon in alt mode.
* Fixed a bug that could prevent Entropy from spawning from a new Rift.
* Fixed a bug that would cause unlocked research to not notify Production Structures to start crafting their new recipe.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.1.418 - bugfix fallout from performance improvements
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for your patience and bug reports.
I think this is the last of the bugs from Thursday's performance patch. 
To recap changes since 410:

[list]
[*] Fixed a rare bug that would prevent your save game from loading because of the Library's Simple Chest.
[*] Fix Ichor Slick and Underground Slab removal logic not returning the item it removed.
[*] Inventory now removes from back to front again.
[*] Fix visuals root fighting with structure mana over whether or not the power out symbol should be visible.
[*] Underground stream/slab now properly cleans up references from all logistics tiles, including invisible ones
[*] Fix race condition where switching planes could cause the main portal to close and enough time to pass where the portal would "close" triggering the end end game flow.
[*] Chunk loading was not centered on the player just after a load.
[*] Power grids should no longer have a delay when run off of pools.
[*] Earth prism and keystone tooltips now properly say reagent instead of structure
[*] Fractured research no longer keeps stale title references
[*] Don't let 1 empty mana pool cause others to completely drain. (fixes nighttime drain too)
[*] Fixed a bug with mana pools bridging networks and causing interplanar issues
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.414 - Performance, Rituals, Air Power Updates
notes.notes:
[h2]UPDATE #2[/h2]
Ok every issue I've seen reported so far with incorrect behavior has been resolved. That doesn't mean there isn't more there though, so please continue to send reports as you see them. Also make sure your game is on version 414.


[h2]UPDATE[/h2]
Hey gang, looks like the perf improvements indeed added a little instability, I'm reverting back to 402 so I can fix a few things up tomorrow and your saves won't have odd behavior in the meantime. Will push an update tomorrow. If you have a compromised save for any reason (shouldn't happen but just in case), please reply to this thread and I will personally fix your save file. Thank you for your patience.

_____________________________________________

[h3]Feature Updates[/h3]
[b]Rituals:[/b]
[list]
[*] Echo Catcher tuned to 20% chance from 10%
[*] Unshattered Blazecaps and Cloudcaps - Air and Fire have 2 new rituals each for you to explore
[*] Runeshroom now costs 500 Power all the time but will only turn on when the network is fully powered. Prevents Rituals turning on and off when they help create power.
[*] Added new constellation icons to the Runeshroom window.
[/list]

[b]Significant Wind Power Update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Turbine starting range +1; starting open-air value to 3 from 5 (results in a baseline value of 153 from 135)
[*] Chasm benefit from Updraft is now +4, unaffected by wind, increasing the Power floor
[*] Entropy (How From Beyond) and Wind Shear (Cloudcap Ritual) now grant +7 per tile.
[*] Gale Generators increase the value of all open-air tiles in their network by 3.
* Runeshroom now costs 500 Power all the time but will only turn on when the network is fully powered. Prevents Rituals turning on and off when they help create power.
[/list]

[h3]QOL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mystical Agrictulture can now be toggled off with Ctrl while Biorhythm is active.
[*] Riptide pickup and Mystical Agriculture toggle states now persist between play sessions.
[*] Black and White power out icon for buildings shut down by Entropy
[*] MMB will quickly send items to trash
[/list]

[h3]Performance Update[/h3]
[i]Many of these are significant refactors of existing systems, please report any odd behavior in your existing factories that feels like it was working before but is not now. I'm not expecting anything, but many many things were jostled to improve performance significantly.
[/i]

[list]
[*] EntityData and StructureData refactor, updated all element associations to a Flags list (this would affect opposite plane placing rules)
[*] Simulation for structures off screen has been significantly reduced.
[*] Significant passes checking whether objects should be in use or not.
[*] Cached math calculations in grippers.
[*] Refactor belt chains, cap their calculations to 60hz, allowing garbage collection to run on off frames if you are above 60 fps)
[*] Don't show or update power vis tiles on other planes.
[*] Turn off ichor slick visual when its culled. 
[*] IsCoordInEntropy now has much better broad phase filtering.
[*] Created a custom tilemap system for sparse information without the need for visuals or collision.
[*] Updated Power out is now run from a shared material instead of a structure coroutine.
[*] Culling now happens based on current zoom instead of fixed based on max zoom. 
[*] Improve perf when a chunk with entropy becomes visible. 
[*] Moved around miner logic so its doing less of the same work multiple times in the same frame.
[*] We can now pick up multiple items in one call from PlaceGrab. This is mainly to reduce the repeated work when trying to do earth grippers. 
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Create Plane Portals as part of save load. Before we were relying on you getting close enough to the chunk to create them. This will fix issues where you'd lose a portal power or belt connection if you were too far away from the portal when loading the game. You will have to at least once get close enough to the portal to "wake the portal up" but after that it should always load correctly without disconnecting your power or belt networks. 
[*] Crafting corner caps to elipsis in save load 
[*] Fix an issue where Bastion could consume ammo twice as fast as it is supposed to.
[*] Fix bug where mana cultivators would be pegged at 100% speed if their saturation was at 100%. It should be the inverse: consumed / total. 
[*] Fix for cloud save display when no other saves exist.
[*] Fix issue with miners that were in progress on save. 
[*] Fix inventory cache being wrong for empty slot count.
[*] Air Plane should no longer be a disco at night.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v0.1.402 - Fixing a dupe bug, plus a few easy wins
notes.notes:
* Dropping onto an inventory slot with the same item will not add to overflow. (thus preventing the dupe bug)
* Evening Bloom tooltip had a broken token
* Streamway Delta no longer leaves invisible references behind to interfere with Shifting Slab tiles
* Ritual lines no longer show on tech tree or through planes
* Cap Mushroom harvest time reduced to .25 sec

notes.title: Patch v0.1.401 - Steam Cloud Support and a menagerie of fixes.
notes.notes:
I don't know how to categorize these, just think of me as a mad bomber this week  :)  Moving on to more Rituals and Perf as the main focus next week, but I'm sure there will be plenty more random adds like always.  Thanks for all of your bug reports and suggestions!

[h3]Better Saving![/h3]
[list]
[*] Steam cloud save support.
[*] Save Files can now be deleted. (Note - if using One Drive, there will be an folder left behind)
[*] Added Rich Steam presence for fun.
[/list]

[h3]QoL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rifts will not spawn on Mote Fields if they haven't been touched for more than 5 minutes. For old saves there may be wonky behavior for the very next spawn per rift since the timer is newly tracked.
[*] Added a lot of protections around deleting your held item when inventory is full.  Items that overflow your inventory will attempt to add themselves back consistently until there is space to do so.
[*] Altar and Pedestal harvest times have been reduced.
[*] Action Bar loadouts has a tooltiphelper for hotkeys.
[*] Control clicking on a recipe in a production structure will now evenly fill with the recipe instead of favoring the first ingredient
[*] Hand-Crafting corner now saves instead of getting cleared.
[/list]

[h3]Coral Pools[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fire and Mushroom Corals are now properly gated behind research
[*] Variety of fixes for Coral Pool Window around formatting and localization
[*] Coral Pool Corals will now grow in the world after being planted, added a bit of water fx for fun.
[/list]
[h3]Lots of Bug and Behavior Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Echo Catcher Runeshroom Ritual now functions properly, more Rituals coming soon!
[*] Altars should no longer eat their currently active research on game load.
[*] Fixed bugs around pedestals clearing items even if they fail to transfer to the target inventory. 
[*] Molten core will only count powered generators.
[*] Cultivator Power recipes no longer scale above 1.0. (causing them to burn faster than 3 or 9 seconds if the networks draw was greater than output.
[*] Power storage now counts as power used when its eating excess power (ie storing it in Mana Pools).
[*] Lava pedestals are now blocked behind research. -- If you don't have the lava pedestals research, lava will eat all your pedestals like everything else.
[*] Elemental Orb sub windows will no longer be blocked based on reach range from accessing the great portal window
[*] Fixed bugs with belts losing track of their order if they are rotated while some slots are empty. 
[*] Harvest removed slots when rotating belts. Since this happens after the old structure is harvested, during the creation of the new structure, these can end up in overflow. 
[*] Fix fire earth portal inventory size. 
[*] Fix fire earth and life earth portal colliders so they contain the chest. 
[*] Gripping directly to the portal key slot can no longer overflow into other containers on the structure. 
[*] Air Gripper flip logic is now blocked behind research.  -- Loading an air gripper that was flipped without having the research will now rotate it 180 degrees.
[*] Mystical agriculture now works on other planes as intended.
[*] Shadows on structures fade up instead of popping in.
[*] Ritual preview no longer hides when the window closes. Hides when the last viewed shroom is destroyed or it goes out of reach. 
[*] Fixed a variety of string typos, bad references, and localization.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v0.1.391 - More Localization
notes.notes: Found and fixed a variety of localization bugs in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Turkish

notes.title: Localization Hotfix v.0.1.387
notes.notes:
[b]Chinese (and possibly other languages) broken Localization Hotfix[/b]

There was a very significant bug that could cause some UI's to not properly load if the localization token had incorrect formatting, Planar Portals were the worst offender (you could not interact with the UI at all), but there were others affected in minor ways. I deeply apologize for the lack of care here, any help with anything regarding localization is super appreciated.

* Fixed Chinese string tokens for planar portals, power windows, time of day
* Added defense against bad tokens - if this ever happens again, just the string will break and not the whole window
If you see any weirdness in strings (beyond Gale Generator tooltip, known, will fix soon)

* Also found and fixed a bug - Portal Keystones are actually an hour now as the previous patch note stated.

notes.title: Patch v0.1.374
notes.notes:
[h2]Let the weekly patches commence![/h2]

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Multiple Action Bars are in![/b] You can use pg up / pg down (rebindable) to cycle between them or Ctrl 1-6 to direct select. 
[*] End Of Game - You can now open the portal back to the Library with a (very brief) end of game flow. In the future you will be able to launch challenge runs from the library, very looking forward to building that system.
[*] Bunches of loc updates.
[/list]

[h3]New Hotkey - Flip [F][/h3]
[list]
[*] F is a new key that 'Flips' - Rotates +3 in build mode (or counterrotates if only 3 rotations). [u]This shares a bind with Pickup but can be rebound[/u], still deciding what defaults are and don't want to break people's muscle memory... yet.
[*] Placed belts can be flipped. 
[*] Placed gust funnels can be rotated and flipped.
[/list]

[h3]QoL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mouse click icon will show up in the intro if you don't click the book for 8 seconds.
[*] Research nodes with Spells and Synergy now show in their respective tooltips for easier tracking.
[*] Many Structures can now be built on top of each other (Chests, Mushrooms, Fire Power poles). 
[*] If a Structure is built on top of another Structure of the same type it can transfer its inventory to the new structure, excess items will be harvested. 
[*] Rotating Slabs and Streamways in place will follow the same logic so you don't pickup a full set every time you rotate.
[/list]

[h3]Aesthetics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tooltips updated with new width to give more room for localization.
[*] Rule Tiles should now be properly lit during night time.
[*] Spells in the research tree have a new hexagonal frame, coded per element.
[*] Updated research Icons in the research tree to better match crafting Icons.
[*] Shrink gripper scale 10% for better spacing.
[*] Adjusted Swiftstone alpha to clean out a couple of gaps.
[*] The pickup sound for items will now wait until the UI message displays. 
[/list]

[h3]Tuning[/h3]
[list]
[*] Block tight left and tight right inside track on undergrounds when there is only one input. [u]This is mostly a bug fix, but it will likely break some of your builds.[/u] Sorry! Hopefully this new functionality will open up a lot of possibilities. A wide turn will still let both lanes through.
[*] Underground Slab stack size now 50
[*] Stack sizes for combo buildings made more consistent.
[*] Keystone duration up to an hour until there is actual gameplay around it
[*] Updated Shadow research to require elemental shadow as intended
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lava generator Heat should now save and load correctly.
[*] slight action bar visual polish
[*] Spells now save with your Action Bar.
[*] Seismic flare should no longer lose track of the Great Portal
[*] Changed the way Seismic flare keeps track of portals - instead of currently visible chunks it will keep a record of all chunks visited and find nearest that way. If a line doesn't show up, you've never been close enough.
[*] Improve performance around localization lookups.
[*] Nitor now correctly tagged as salt (was Water, preventing placement on Fire)
[*] Fixed a bug that would make Mana Flare animate very slowly when far away from origin.
[*] Elements on the spell Hex have been localized.
[*] Mana pools can only ever count once in a mana wells max storage calculation even if they are coming from multiple grids. 
[*] When a mana well is created make sure its max storage is calculated without waiting for the powergrid to tell it to update. 
[*] When a mana well is disconnected from a power grid, decay over a few seconds to the new max. 
[*] Pipette now correctly picks up the flipped status of grippers.
[*] Fix material jitter when all mana well and mana pool vfx have the same "health" value.
[*] Research tip window should appropriately hide things
[*] Elemental Orb Tooltips fixed for Anchor Stones
[*] Torrential Streams now show their correct speeds
[*] Torrential Slipstreams now save and load correctly
[*] Torrential Slipstream correctly labeled logistics
[/list]

notes.title: July 6 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h2]v0.1.332[/h2][p][/p][p]Keep that feedback coming! Many improvements made here are the direct result of feedback from players like you. Thank you for helping to make MoteMancer magnificent :)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tuning[/b][/p][list][*][p]Research Trees have been significantly re-tuned, many branches now add Ingredients rather than replacing[/p][/*][*][p]Later game Recipes have been retuned to make long automation crafting chains more approachable[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Entropy Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Entropy now spawns much faster after disturbing a Mote Field, giving you an opportunity to plan[/p][/*][*][p]Entropy Spawns further away but continues to grow on a much longer tail[/p][/*][*][p]Significantly increased the duration between entropy respawns.[/p][/*][*][p]Entropy now affects power-generating structures[/p][/*][*][p]Many unique Tower Upgrades implemented to combat Entropy.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Functionality[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Shifting Slabs can transfer to Streamways and vice versa.[/p][/*][*][p]Inter-planar logistics via portals implemented, currently is not gated behind anything but is likely to require active keystones to maintain the connection.[/p][/*][*][p]Mana Pools and Primordial Manawells fully implemented, they can be used as a way to bridge power networks and have their own internal Power storage. Added visuals to indicate their fullness.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quality of Life[/b][/p][list][*][p]Player Inventory Trashing implemented, will only show up when your inventory has 5 or fewer empty slots[/p][/*][*][p]Action bar button polish, hover tips take a moment to show up unless moving from button to button[/p][/*][*][p]Can place ichor slick over belts[/p][/*][*][p]Added research to have Riptide also works on salt slabs[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory now alternates row and column upgrades, was 12 rows x 6 cols, now 9x9[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where Incinerator laser visuals might not clean up[/p][/*][*][p]Burrowroot art now sorts across planes properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fix manual crafting not checking for research unlocks[/p][/*][*][p]Firewire now visually connects to the nearest Lava Barrier[/p][/*][*][p]Variety of Localization fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Variety of Perf improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always, please remember to submit bugs and suggestions directly in game![/p][p]~CyanAvatar[/p]

notes.title: Jun 27 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h2]v0.1.324[/h2][p]Thanks for being patient I know it's been a while since the last update, this new patch was a doozy.  Plenty of Quality of life for both Demo and Beta builds, and Entropy is now available for testing.[/p][h3]Entropy[/h3][list][*][p]Entropy is now an active and regenerating threat. Rifts are the source of where Entropy will spread from. Rifts will spawn once you've entered another Plane near any Mote Field you've been collecting from.[/p][/*][*][p]Entropy can be cleansed with spells (currently Riptide only) and Downpour Bastion, which will create a field of cleansing, but Rifts themselves can only be sealed with an Incineration Spire. The more planes you visit, the more aggressive the Rifts will become.[/p][/*][*][p]Remember that Entropy pierces the planes, so a Mote Field on one plane can interfere with your base on other Planes.[/p][/*][*][p]Entropy now persist through saves[/p][/*][*][p]Intro sequence uses the new entropy system but appears close to what it was before[/p][/*][*][p]Structures with power consumption will now be at 0 power if any part of their footprint is in entropy.[/p][/*][*][p]The Great Portal is now capable of having the Elemental Orbs be replenished with Keystones and Catalysts. Please give feedback on the UI, there's still work to do but the main request is to make sure it feels intuitive enough.[/p][/*][*][p]Collision should be fixed for the Anchor Stones near the Great Portal[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]QOL[/h3][list][*][p]Mouseover tooltips have been significantly reworked to show more information that is contextual to whatever you are hovering over. Please give feedback on this. Mote Fields and Entropy/Rift tips coming shortly.[/p][/*][*][p]Add preview arrows to all belts[/p][/*][*][p]Collector specialization now shows colored text to help draw attention[/p][/*][*][p]Infusion Altars will now show mismatching ingredients with a red slot if there is no research for that ingredient available[/p][/*][*][p]Slight right offset to item counts while holding to prevent cursor getting in the way of held count[/p][/*][*][p]Hitting escape during an interactive rebind will now unbind that key.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Tuning[/h3][list][*][p]Recipe updates for diamonds, charged lodestone, quintessence[/p][/*][*][p]Mana Bloom initial power area +1 radius[/p][/*][*][p]Fire Wire and Thermal Tower initial power area +1 radius[/p][/*][*][p]Tree of Life Research 1 and 2 tuned back to 30 and 50[/p][/*][*][p]Infusion Altar now takes 100 power to operate[/p][/*][*][p]Mana Flare now generates 500 Power[/p][/*][*][p]Coral Pool power cost now 1000[/p][/*][*][p]Air power now generates 5 per open-air tile, from 2[/p][/*][*][p]Fire power buffed significantly and is now more in line with Air and Life[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Art updates[/h3][list][*][p]Second Shadow music track added![/p][/*][*][p]Added a thin line to the outside range of Biorhythm and Downpour Bastion[/p][/*][*][p]Art polish passes for: [/p][/*][*][p]Mana Pool[/p][/*][*][p]Primordial Manawell[/p][/*][*][p]Downpour Bastion[/p][/*][*][p]Coral Pool[/p][/*][*][p]Ritual Shrooms[/p][/*][*][p]Reef Crafter[/p][/*][*][p]All Grippers[/p][/*][*][p]Vortex Miner[/p][/*][*][p]Zephyrmill[/p][/*][*][p]Incineration Spire[/p][/*][*][p]Void Chest[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Coral Pools now save and load properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a variety of ways buildings could not be harvested or interacted with, mostly from interference from other Planes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bad verdant stream collider[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would allow you to dupe Fire Wire[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause your player to get stuck if pressing Q while casting a spell[/p][/*][*][p]Attempting to force game to run while in background to fix the few folks who have reported it.  This is inconsistent, please give feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where info text could block mouse input randomly[/p][/*][*][p]Walking near a Tidal Collector should sort with the player properly now[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a variety of ways fire power could load improperly[/p][/*][*][p]More defense against overlapping aspect states[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a variety of Collector Crystal FX that weren't sorting properly[/p][/*][*][p]Roots under buildings should no longer break Nudge[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]Thanks again for all the feedback, suggestions, and bug reports, keep them coming![/i][/p][p][i]~CyanAvatar[/i][/p]

notes.title: Jun 18 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h2]Build v0.1.313[/h2][p]Thanks everyone for all the feedback, bug reports, and suggestions.  There's still plenty more to do but here's a quick recap of the last two weeks of work.  More frequent patches are posted in the community discord.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Features & QOL[/b][/p][list][*][p]Support for crafting items from action bar when empty, left click for 1 right click for 5[/p][/*][*][p]Added contextual hover tip for action bar with a variety of states and indicators based on what each mouse button will do[/p][/*][*][p]Production Structures now allow for clicking on recipes to transfer items from the player inventory to the input inventory: Click will move one set of ingredients, Shift Click for 5, Ctrl Click for all matching ingredients[/p][/*][*][p]Hand crafting speed is doubled when you have available mana - Added a visual to crafting corner as an indicator[/p][/*][*][p]All Life power structures and combo structures with roots can be built ontop of Mana Roots[/p][/*][*][p]Power outage indicators are now synchronized[/p][/*][*][p]Raw crafting counts now uses ratios with multi-crafts[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting Corner now only shows two rows of crafts[/p][/*][*][p]Riptide pickups now clump a little more to avoid +1 spam[/p][/*][*][p]Feedback from now pauses game when open[/p][/*][*][p]Added more research flavor tips, some are disabled for non-english languages if not yet localized[/p][/*][*][p]Main menu button implemented on Escape Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Action Bar slot will dim and hide count when the matching entity has no items left[/p][/*][*][p]Action bar now matches picked up entity with a highlight[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Tuning / Pacing[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Testing size 1 Output inventory to encourage more logistical play rather than pooling play. - please give feedback on this![/p][/*][*][p]Game-wide research cost tuning, most focused on early game pacing and shoring up late game consistency.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved Mana Roots to unlock simultaneously with Tree of life research, leaving mana bloom its own research immediately after[/p][/*][*][p]Swapped Reach and Rampant bloom in the Life research tree (because roots as a thing to automate streamlines with this better, also unlocks it sooner)[/p][/*][*][p]Gust Funnel ingredients now 1 Turbine and 3 Aether for 3 Gust Funnels[/p][/*][*][p]Swapped the order of tutorial 6's gripper/collector beats for better flow[/p][/*][*][p]Research tuning: second arm of research now adds instead of replaces Aether.[/p][/*][*][p]Earth Might (Earth grippers pick up 2 things) upgrade moved to tier 1[/p][p]Air grippers can be flipped with F, this will be locked behind tech later, but for now enjoy![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Art & Implementation[/b][/p][list][*][p]Art updates for: Earth chests, Wave Wright, Luminarium, Pyrolyzer, Cinder Collector, Sovereign Manaheart, Tide Collector[/p][/*][*][p]Added Fractured Research as a means to create stubs for unimplemented tech without breaking immersion[/p][/*][*][p]Research line grooves are a little clearer[/p][/*][*][p]Two new Air music tracks have been added [/p][/*][*][p]One new Fire music track has been added [/p][/*][*][p]All three void chests work now and have inventory size 6[/p][/*][*][p]Verdant Stream and Verdant Delta are implemented [/p][/*][*][p]Ancient Chest and Basalt Chest fully functional[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Last Crafted should now be saved in save games to support Alt mode consistency[/p][/*][*][p]F should now be able to pick up from undergrounds,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for bad colliders near portals that could block harvesting[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a case where quit context could leave the Spell Hex in a bad state[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for research tree quarry collector huge icon,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for toast banner blocking structure placement[/p][/*][*][p]Collectors now build their inventories on the fly, matching upgrades and fixing their UI when Arrays are researched[/p][/*][*][p]Undergrounds and Deltas now use insert positions like normal belts do, allowing grippers to place to all segments[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where action bar would dim in the wrong circumstance,[/p][/*][*][p]Research colors for Altars and Pedestals cleaned up for each element and combo,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes
